availability_evidence: Annual report pages 122 and 131 state that the report was approved by the Board and authorised for issue on 31 March 2020; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue fell 6.5% to €2,922m and adjusted EBITA 8.9% to €408m amid weak steel demand and lower fixed-cost absorption, while working-capital intensity rose to 18.3%. Adjusted EBITA margin remained broadly stable at 14.0%, operating free cash flow was €359m, net debt fell to €650m and leverage improved to 1.2x with €1.1bn liquidity. The report also quantified €112m of restructuring and write-down expense under an announced plant-optimisation plan.
already_announced_exclusion: The Production Optimisation Plan, announced European plant closures and downsizing, corporate reorganisation, Sinterco restructuring, merger synergies, hedging-policy restructuring and associated €112m charges disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Weak steel demand, lower revenue and profit and an extensive announced footprint programme create moderate pressure, but stable margins, strong cash generation, lower leverage and substantial liquidity provide powerful offsets.

availability_evidence: Annual report pages 123 and 131 state that the report was approved by the Board on 25 February 2022 and authorised for issue on 27 February 2022; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue rose 13% to €2,551m and adjusted EBITA 8% to €280m, but supply-chain, energy and raw-material headwinds reduced adjusted EBITDA margin from 16.8% to 15.2% and adjusted EBITA margin from 11.5% to 11.0%. Working capital rose from €369m to €677m, operating cash flow reversed from €290m to negative €236m, free cash flow from positive €101m to negative €427m, and net debt rose from €583m to €1,014m with leverage at 2.6x.
already_announced_exclusion: The Trieben closure, Dashiqiao impairment, Mainzlar and other Production Optimisation Plan decisions, 540-role head-office restructuring, Magnifin disposal and cost-saving initiatives disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Severe working-capital consumption, negative operating and free cash flow, sharply higher debt and above-target leverage create very high pressure. Revenue and adjusted-profit growth partly offset this, but margins contracted under substantial cost headwinds.

availability_evidence: Annual report pages 173 and 183 state that the report and financial statements were approved and authorised for issue by the Board on 28 February 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue rose 8% to €3,572m, adjusted EBITDA 9% to €543m, gross margin by 100bps to 24.0%, adjusted EBITA 7% to €409m and adjusted operating cash flow from €155m to €413m. Free cash flow rose to €258m and base-business working capital fell. However, base-business sales volumes and EBITA declined, adjusted EBITA margin slipped from 11.6% to 11.4%, leverage remained 2.3x, fixed-cost absorption was low, and SG&A rose 20%; M&A supplied much of the growth.
already_announced_exclusion: The focused SG&A headcount reduction, €11m restructuring programme, plant closures and network optimisation, Production Optimisation Plan, 2023 acquisitions and related integration actions disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Subdued underlying demand, lower base-business volumes and margin, elevated leverage and cost pressure create moderate pressure. Strong reported growth, gross-margin expansion, cash conversion above 100% and substantially higher free cash flow provide strong offsets.
